use default

let width = 48

blank() -> LIST[int] is
    let digits = LIST[int]()

    for _ in 0..width do
        digits.add(0)
    od

    digits
si

copy(value: List[int]) -> LIST[int] is
    let digits = blank()

    for index in 0..width do
        digits[index] = value[index]
    od

    digits
si

read(text: string) -> LIST[int] is
    let digits = blank()

    for entry in text |> reverse() |> index() do
        digits[entry.index] = if entry.value == '1' then 1 else 0 fi
    od

    digits
si

highest(value: List[int]) -> int =>
    let found =
        (0..width) |> reverse() |> find(index => value[index] != 0) in
    found ?? -1

show(value: List[int]) -> string =>
    let top = highest(value) in
    if top < 0 then
        "0"
    else
        (0::top) |> reverse() |> map(index => "{value[index]}") |> join("")
    fi

is_zero(value: List[int]) -> bool =>
    (0..width) |> all(index => value[index] == 0)

compare(left: List[int], right: List[int]) -> int is
    for index in (0..width) |> reverse() do
        if left[index] != right[index] then
            return if left[index] > right[index] then 1 else -1 fi
        fi
    od

    0
si

normalise(digits: LIST[int]) is
    let settled mut = false

    while !settled do
        settled = true

        for index in 0..width - 2 do
            if digits[index] >= 1 /\ digits[index + 1] >= 1 then
                digits[index] = digits[index] - 1
                digits[index + 1] = digits[index + 1] - 1
                digits[index + 2] = digits[index + 2] + 1

                settled = false
            fi
        od

        if digits[0] >= 2 then
            digits[0] = digits[0] - 2
            digits[1] = digits[1] + 1

            settled = false
        fi

        if digits[1] >= 2 then
            digits[1] = digits[1] - 2
            digits[2] = digits[2] + 1
            digits[0] = digits[0] + 1

            settled = false
        fi

        for index in 2..width - 1 do
            if digits[index] >= 2 then
                digits[index] = digits[index] - 2
                digits[index + 1] = digits[index + 1] + 1
                digits[index - 2] = digits[index - 2] + 1

                settled = false
            fi
        od
    od
si

add(left: List[int], right: List[int]) -> LIST[int] is
    let total = blank()

    for index in 0..width do
        total[index] = left[index] + right[index]
    od

    normalise(total)

    total
si

decrement(value: List[int]) -> LIST[int] is
    let result = copy(value)
    let lowest = (0..width) |> find(index => result[index] == 1)

    if let at = lowest then
        result[at] = 0

        let index mut = at - 1

        while index >= 0 do
            result[index] = 1
            index = index - 2
        od
    fi

    result
si

subtract(left: List[int], right: List[int]) -> LIST[int] is
    let result mut = copy(left)
    let remaining mut = copy(right)

    while !is_zero(remaining) do
        result = decrement(result)
        remaining = decrement(remaining)
    od

    result
si

fibonacci_multiples(value: List[int], upto: List[int]) -> LIST[LIST[int]] is
    let table = LIST[LIST[int]]()

    table.add(copy(value))
    table.add(add(value, value))

    while compare(table[table.count - 1], upto) <= 0 do
        table.add(add(table[table.count - 1], table[table.count - 2]))
    od

    table
si

multiply(left: List[int], right: List[int]) -> LIST[int] is
    let top = highest(right)

    if top < 0 then
        return blank()
    fi

    let table = LIST[LIST[int]]()

    table.add(copy(left))
    table.add(add(left, left))

    while table.count <= top do
        table.add(add(table[table.count - 1], table[table.count - 2]))
    od

    let total mut = blank()

    for index in 0::top do
        if right[index] == 1 then
            total = add(total, table[index])
        fi
    od

    total
si

use DIVISION = (quotient: LIST[int], remainder: LIST[int])

divide(left: List[int], right: List[int]) -> DIVISION is
    let table = fibonacci_multiples(right, left)
    let quotient = blank()
    let remainder mut = copy(left)

    for index in (0..table.count) |> reverse() do
        if compare(table[index], remainder) <= 0 then
            remainder = subtract(remainder, table[index])
            quotient[index] = quotient[index] + 1
        fi
    od

    normalise(quotient)

    (quotient = quotient, remainder = remainder)
si

write_line("counting:")

let counter mut = blank()

for _ in 1::12 do
    counter = add(counter, one)

    write_line("  {show(counter)}")
od

write_line()
write_line("addition:")

[("1", "1"), ("10", "10"), ("100", "100"), ("1000", "1000"),
 ("10100", "1001")]
    |> each((left, right) => (
        let sum = add(read(left), read(right))

        write_line("  {left} + {right} = {show(sum)}")
    ))

write_line()
write_line("subtraction:")

[("10100", "1000"), ("100100", "1000"), ("1000100", "101")]
    |> each((left, right) => (
        let difference = subtract(read(left), read(right))

        write_line("  {left} - {right} = {show(difference)}")
    ))

write_line()
write_line("multiplication:")

[("101", "1001"), ("1000", "1000"), ("10", "10101")]
    |> each((left, right) => (
        let product = multiply(read(left), read(right))

        write_line("  {left} * {right} = {show(product)}")
    ))

write_line()
write_line("division:")

[("1000101", "101"), ("1000100", "101"), ("101010", "10")]
    |> each((left, right) => (
        let split = divide(read(left), read(right))

        write_line("  {left} / {right} = {show(split.quotient)} "
                   "remainder {show(split.remainder)}")
    ))
